name: ABCD
idea: Within one session: a first leg makes a new session high (B), the pullback holds a higher low (C) above the session's low (A); the signal is the turn back up from C once C is a confirmed swing. The idea is wrong below C.

params.label: Volume against the same time of day
params.help: The bar that makes the new session high (low for the downside): its volume against the same time of day in the previous sessions, at least this many times (0 means no volume condition).

params.label: Close on the side of the session VWAP
params.help: The bar that makes the new session high closes above the session VWAP (below for the downside).

params.label: Quiet minutes after the open
params.help: No new session high counts from a bar that starts in this many minutes from the session's open (0 means none).

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the session's earlier high the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: Swing size
params.help: Which swings count as the high and the higher low: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. A swing is known only once price has come back from it.

params.label: The turn (bars)
params.help: The turn: the close goes above the highest high (below the lowest low for the downside) of this many bars before it.

params.label: Turn within (bars)
params.help: The turn must come within this many bars after the new session high, in the same session.

params.label: ATR period
params.help: The bars of the average true range the distances and buffers are measured in.

params.label: Buffer
params.help: How many average true ranges beyond the higher low (0 means not set: the higher low itself).

params.label: A new low against (bars)
params.help: For the template's exit signal: a close beyond the low (high for the downside) of this many bars before it.

trigger.long: SwingDirection($degree) == "UP" AND SwingHigh($degree) >= SessionHigh()[1] AND SwingLow($degree) > SessionLow() AND close > SwingLow($degree) AND close > Max(high, $turn_n)[1]
trigger.short: SwingDirection($degree) == "DOWN" AND SwingLow($degree) <= SessionLow()[1] AND SwingHigh($degree) < SessionHigh() AND close < SwingHigh($degree) AND close < Min(low, $turn_n)[1]
